title: Indonesia's constitution limits the president to one re-election
summary: Indonesia's constitution limits the president to one re-election.
body: Article 7 says the president and vice president hold office for five years and may subsequently be re-elected to the same office for one further term only. The source says: "Head of state term limits , Head of state term length Article 7 The President and Vice President shall hold office for a term of five years and may subsequently be reelected to the same office for one further term only." The limit is one further term, written in the article.
